verses.1: We give thanks unto thee, O God; We give thanks, for thy name is near: Men tell of thy wondrous works.
verses.2: When I shall find the set time, I will judge uprightly.
verses.3: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I have set up the pillars of it. [Selah
verses.4: I said unto the arrogant, Deal not arrogantly; And to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.5: Lift not up your horn on high; Speak not with a stiff neck.
verses.6: For neither from the east, nor from the west, Nor yet from the south, cometh lifting up.
verses.7: But God is the judge: He putteth down one, and lifteth up another.
verses.8: For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and the wine foameth; It is full of mixture, and he poureth out of the same: Surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.
verses.9: But I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.10: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
